semanticDecisions: the needle's compact value is transient scratch of the needle's size (as the A21 flat-haystack lane already reads it); no precompute stores it, so invariant 6 (no second spelling store) holds

the trigram gates stay in front of the lane: a hot miss the facts reject never reads a window; a cold source or a needle sharing the text's trigrams runs the lane, which is what the exact search now is

the per-unit skip and KMP searches over an M3 source in M3StringSearchPrecompute are no longer reached from String (the flat-haystack lanes still use the plans); their removal is a separate cleanup leaf
a flat needle still takes its own entry (the facts gate, the coder gate, the per-unit guard) and the same window loop; an M3 needle handed to that entry is routed to its lane
